ns2:course.label: Princ Prac Foster Indep Rdg
ns2:course.description: Emphasizes reading comprehension and reading to learn in content fields in grades K-8. Includes focus on teaching reading to students from diverse cultural and linguistic backgrounds, including dialect speakers and English learners. 3 undergraduate hours. 2 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: CI 475, a course in beginning reading, or consent of instructor.
